DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to take a rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴に泥が付いています。屋内へ入る前にどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 泥付き靴の入場方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shoes are muddy. What should I do before going indoors?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to enter with muddy shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 土を落とせる場所を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you where to remove the soil.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花壇でこすらず、指定の場所を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定場所で泥を落とす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use the designated place instead of scraping them in the flowerbed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Remove the mud at the designated place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの入口手前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is just before this entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。歩いた場所に泥が落ちたことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路の落下泥を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will also report that mud fell off where I walked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the mud dropped on the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 清掃担当へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will contact the cleaning staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で通路へ水を流すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無断散水をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not pour water onto the path myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not spray water without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩後は散歩を続けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you continue your walk after resting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いえ、駅へ帰ります。帰りも舗装の道を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰りの舗装経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, I will return to the station. I would like a paved route back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a paved return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 指定場所で靴を整えてから休憩所へどうぞ。帰りはこの舗装道で駅側へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please clean your shoes at the designated place before entering the rest area. This paved path leads back toward the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工事の音で、乗場変更の放送が聞こえませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送未聴取を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not hear the platform-change announcement because of the construction noise.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you could not hear the announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗る便を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which service you are taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時のこの便です。周りの人について移動せず聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象便を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This ten o’clock service. I came to ask instead of following the people around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the relevant service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示板でも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also check the display board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 変更した番号と、この便の行先を一緒に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更番号と行先の文字確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to see the changed platform number together with this service’s destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the changed number and destination in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三番へ変更されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It has changed to platform three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。同行者にも三番の案内を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ確定情報を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will show my companions the information for platform three too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share the confirmed information with your companions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三番へはこの階段です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: These stairs lead to platform three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 移動時間が足りない場合は次便を相談します。走りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理せず次便を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: If there is not enough time to get there, I will ask about the next service. I will not run.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the next service rather than rushing beyond your limits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三番の表示を確認してお進みください。間に合わなければ係員へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the signs for platform three as you go. You can ask a staff member if you cannot make it in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先が住所不要と言いました。住所の載らない物を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所不要の証明を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient said an address is unnecessary. I would like to ask about one without an address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a certificate that does not show an address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定書類は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which document is specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前だけ聞きました。この案内を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出指定を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only told its name. Please look at these instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the submission requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行できる記載項目を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which particulars can be included on the issued document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出た書類の住所を自分で黒く塗る方法にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己黒塗りを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not black out the address myself after it is issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid blacking out the information yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象者はご本人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you the person the certificate concerns?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私一人です。他の家族分は必要ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象者を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, only me. I do not need documents for other family members.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the subject to yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の必要項目も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also confirm which particulars the recipient needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発行条件と必要項目が合ってから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要項目確認後に申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will apply after the issuing conditions match the required particulars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply after confirming the required particulars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人一人の記載項目の相談として担当へご案内します。案内紙をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the person in charge to discuss the particulars for you alone. Please bring the instructions as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the medical-provider field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬を受け取る薬局を書きましたが、診察は別の医院です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 医院と薬局の記入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the pharmacy where I collect medicine, but I receive consultations at a different clinic.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about entering the clinic and pharmacy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その二つを分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check those two separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 医院の名前はこちらです。薬局を診察した場所とは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察した医院を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the clinic name. I will not list the pharmacy as where I saw the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the clinic where you were seen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後の診察はいつですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先月十日です。薬を受け取った昨日とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診察日と受取日を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The tenth of last month. That is different from yesterday when I collected the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the consultation date from the collection date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬の情報もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the medicine information too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋があります。診察日と受取日を別に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋の情報を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the bag. Please check the consultation date separately from the collection date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the bag information separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ内容を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass the details to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。通院欄の訂正方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Please also explain how to correct the medical-provider field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct the entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 医院、診察日、薬局と受取日を区別して引き継ぎます。用紙の訂正方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will distinguish the clinic and consultation date from the pharmacy and collection date when handing this over. We will explain how to correct the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a suspicious message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 解約後の返金のために、先に保証金を送れと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返金前の送金要求を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to send a deposit first to receive a refund after cancellation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a payment demand before receiving a refund. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。返金を受ける話と追加の支払いを分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金と二手続を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I want to distinguish receiving a refund from making an additional payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not paid and distinguish the two procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡経路を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 解約先のようなメールです。前から知る窓口にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既知窓口で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: An email that looks like it came from the canceled service. I will also check with the contact I already know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with a previously known contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メッセージは残してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。相手のリンクを開かず、原文を相談担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: リンクを使わず原文保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will show the original text to the adviser without opening the sender’s link.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the original message without using its link. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相手へ返事しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you replied to the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: していません。期日を急がれても今は払いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急かされても支払い保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. Even if they pressure me about a deadline, I will not pay now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off paying even under pressure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 要求の内容と未送金を記録し、担当へおつなぎします。元の契約窓口で返金の状況も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record the demand and that you have not paid, then connect you to the person in charge. Please also check the refund status with your original contract contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 菓子と保冷剤です。保冷剤の種類も確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保冷剤も内容として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Snacks and a cooling pack. I would like the cooling-pack type checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Include the cooling pack in your description of the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋です。普通の氷だと決めず見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 種類表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the bag. I will show it without assuming it is ordinary ice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the type label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配送条件を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the delivery conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冷たい状態が続く保証は、保冷剤だけで決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保冷持続を決めつけない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume the cooling pack alone guarantees it stays cold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume cooling will last. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取先と時間の希望は。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: What destination and delivery time would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人宅へ明日です。不在なら保管条件も心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取先と不在時の懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend’s home tomorrow. I am also concerned about storage if they are out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the destination and your concern about an absent recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件確認後に方法を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can choose a method after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取予定も友人へ聞いてから出します。今日は未発送です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取確認後に発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my friend about their availability before sending. It has not been sent today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send after confirming the recipient’s availability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容、保冷材、受取状況を確認して案内します。条件が分かるまで封を閉じずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the contents, cooling material and recipient’s availability before advising. Please leave it unsealed until the conditions are clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check an entry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 摘要に相手の名前を書きました。請求番号を入れる欄でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 摘要の指定を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the recipient’s name in the reference field. Is this where the invoice number goes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what should go in the reference field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 依頼文の指定を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the instructions in the payment request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内です。相手名と照合用の文字を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手名と請求照合文字を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. Please distinguish the recipient name from the reference text used to match the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the recipient’s name from the invoice-matching reference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座情報も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will also check the account information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ相手でも、前の請求番号を使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧番号を使わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even for the same recipient, I will not use the previous invoice number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use the old number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ実行していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not made the transfer yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今回の番号と金額で見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未実行で今回内容を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I would like to review it using this invoice’s number and amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it is not executed and check the current details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相手先へ不明点を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you ask the recipient about anything unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡します。文字を省略して勝手に送らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明文字を依頼元へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact them. I will not abbreviate the text and send the money on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the requester about unclear reference text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 依頼文を確認してから各欄を入力してください。受取人と摘要は別の情報として照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the payment request before filling each field. We will compare the recipient and reference as separate information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの瓶は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are the bottles you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返却したい空瓶です。新しい飲料も買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空瓶返却と購入を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Empty bottles I want to return. I will also buy a new drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to return empty bottles and make a purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返却の対象を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check whether the bottles are eligible for return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二本です。新しい瓶の数へ混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却数と購入数を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two. Please do not include them in the number of new bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the returned quantity from the purchase quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身は残っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空です。自分で売場の棚へ戻さず、ここへ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空の状態で受付へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are empty. I will hand them to you here instead of putting them back on the sales shelf myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand the empty bottles to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返却分の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check how the returns are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい飲料の代金と、返却の記録を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録と代金を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to check the new drink’s payment separately from the return record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the record separately from the payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい飲料は一本ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You are buying one new drink, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。新商品だけ袋に入れ、会計の内訳を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新商品だけ袋入れを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please bag only the new product; I will check the checkout breakdown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for only the new product to be bagged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 空瓶二本を受付で確認し、新しい一本は別に会計します。返却品は売場へお戻しにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the two empty bottles at the counter and charge separately for the new one. Please do not return the empty bottles to the sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、枝が落ちた所で曲がりました。今日は枝がなく迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 消えた一時目印で迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I turned where a branch had fallen. Today the branch is gone and I lost my way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you got lost after a temporary landmark disappeared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日と今の案内を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish yesterday’s landmarks from the information now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 枝を動かして目印に戻すのではなく、案内板を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枝を戻さず案内板を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to check the information board rather than move the branch back to make the landmark again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an information board instead of putting the branch back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今いるのは東の広場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You are now in the east plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅側へ帰りたいです。道の正式な目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的出口と恒常目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to return toward the station. Please tell me the official route landmarks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your destination exit and ask for permanent landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この道の二つ目の案内板で右です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turn right at the second information board along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。残っている落下枝にも近寄りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 落下枝へ近寄らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not approach any remaining fallen branches either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not approach fallen branches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you stop to rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いえ、その道で出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認経路で帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, I will head for the exit along that route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return along the confirmed route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つ目の案内板から右の出口へどうぞ。移動した枝を道案内の根拠にしないようご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please turn toward the right-hand exit at the second board. Do not use a branch that has been moved as your basis for directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えの家族が、元の到着時刻で駅へ来ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの旧時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family has come to the station to meet me according to the original arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your family is waiting based on the old arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗る列車はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この便です。今の到着見込みを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象便の見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This service. I would like to know the current estimated arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the estimate for your service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在は十五分遅れです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is currently delayed by fifteen minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十五分後に必ず着くとは伝えず、案内時点も添えて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時点付きの情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not say it will definitely arrive fifteen minutes from now. I will include when the information was given when I contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pass on information with its time of issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち場所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check where they are waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族は車なので、道路で待ち続けず駐車場へ移ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車の待機場所を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family is driving, so I will ask them to move to a car park instead of continuing to wait on the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Adjust the car’s waiting location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更情報は表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check updates on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗る便を変える時は家族にも連絡します。今はこの便を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 便変更時の連絡を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I change trains, I will tell my family too. For now I will wait for this service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will notify them if you change services. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の案内をお渡しします。到着見込みが変われば、迎えの方にも更新してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you the current information. If the arrival estimate changes, please update the person meeting you too.
